..reason: Repository orchestration uses Node test runner and spawned tools; native Vitest does not instrument those subprocesses.

scripts.reason: Most tooling behavioral tests use node:test and subprocesses; no validated mutation activation across them.

infra.reason: Configuration and shell provisioning; native TypeScript mutations do not instrument the shell implementation.

limitations.reason: NATS reuse includes only durable publication/replay in events.integration.test.ts. Size/configuration/rejection and other NATS lifetime/network suites stay independent. S3/image-worker ownership/reset and built subprocess activation remain unvalidated.

Normal integration uses the Redis adapter contract and composed admission scenario. The explicit fixed OpenSearch Profile discovery opt-in selects only profiles.ts and its existing seven-case in-process contract, initially isolated; activation/reset/cleanup/benefit acceptance remains pending under #518. It does not add automatic OpenSearch coverage. Other search, NATS and subprocess fixtures remain unvalidated.

PostgreSQL, S3 and NATS fixtures use a process-global Testcontainers reaper. Cancellation-safe invocation ownership and reset isolation need validation before integration opt-in. Built subprocess output is also unvalidated.

S3 selects only the existing exact-byte/missing-object reader contract with a private SeaweedFS backend reused serially by default; isolated per-mutation diagnostics remain available. Scoped acceptance evidence and limits are tracked under #517. Image subprocesses, lifetime/destructive/network/configuration suites and other PostgreSQL/NATS fixtures remain excluded from mutation integration.

PostgreSQL and NATS fixtures use a process-global Testcontainers reaper. Cancellation-safe invocation ownership and reset isolation need validation before integration opt-in. Built subprocess output is also unvalidated.

PostgreSQL pilot includes only profile-store operation tests. Database lifetime/cancellation suites retain independent containers. Other PostgreSQL, S3 and picture-worker fixtures need separate ownership/reset validation. Built subprocess output remains unvalidated.

S3, NATS and image-worker fixtures use a process-global Testcontainers reaper. Cancellation-safe invocation ownership and reset isolation need validation before integration opt-in. Built subprocess output is also unvalidated.
Only the Node project is enabled. jsdom and real browser execution require a known active mutation before support is claimed.

packages/biome-test-rules.reason: Biome plugins execute in an isolated runtime; CLI subprocesses and the Node algorithm contracts have no validated native Vitest mutation activation.

packages/core.reason: The unit database health probe opens an unowned localhost:59999 PostgreSQL endpoint. Control this external input before enabling mutations. Integration container ownership/reset and subprocess activation also remain unvalidated.

packages/react-muuri.reason: Browser and jsdom execution need a known active mutation verified with native runner and framework plugins before support is claimed.

packages/test-utils.reason: Container fixture implementation requires separate multi-family isolation and activation validation; ordinary E2E coverage is insufficient.

packages/testcontainers.reason: Container/reaper suites include child processes whose mutation activation is unvalidated.

packages/url-ipv4-resolver.reason: The resolver suite uses live DNS for example.com; deterministic resolver inputs must be validated before repeated mutation execution.

packages/vitest-config.reason: Shared configuration only; invalidate all dependent suites instead of claiming a standalone score.
